answer: Inter-arrival rhythm enrollment. Each identity must submit its first N transactions with human-plausible gaps and burst sizes; the agent then checks later traffic against that stored rhythm, flagging deviations beyond a tolerance band. Sybils must either fake consistent pacing per identity, costing compute and delay per puppet, or buy aged accounts—an expensive oasis few attackers sustain. A walnut of randomness in each schedule defeats replay, and any river of synchronized signups collapses into one detectable cluster.
